es: Negociar un plan compartido de compañeros de piso: intercambiar ofertas, ceder dos veces y registrar el acuerdo final con sus condiciones.

teaching.en: Their total budget is six hundred dollars a month.
teaching.es: Su presupuesto total es de seiscientos dólares al mes.
teaching.explanationEs: Total: la suma final. Conviene fijar primero la cifra total antes de repartirla.
teaching.audioText: Their total budget is six hundred dollars a month.

teaching.en: Leo offers to pay the rent provided that Mia pays the bills.
teaching.es: Leo ofrece pagar el alquiler siempre que Mia pague las facturas.
teaching.explanationEs: Una oferta con condición: provided that + presente simple, nunca will.
segments: Leo offers to pay the rent
provided that Mia pays the bills.
teaching.audioText: Leo offers to pay the rent provided that Mia pays the bills.

teaching.en: Mia makes a concession: she will pay a little more for the internet.
teaching.es: Mia hace una concesión: pagará un poco más por internet.
teaching.explanationEs: Concession: cedes algo para acercarte al otro, y lo dices de forma explícita.
segments: Mia makes a concession: she will pay
a little more for the internet.
teaching.audioText: Mia makes a concession: she will pay a little more for the internet.

teaching.en: Leo's second concession: he is ready to give in on the cooking.
teaching.es: La segunda concesión de Leo: está dispuesto a ceder con la cocina.
teaching.explanationEs: Give in on + tema significa ceder en algo. Ceder dos veces ayuda a cerrar.
segments: Leo's second concession: he is ready
to give in on the cooking.
teaching.audioText: Leo's second concession: he is ready to give in on the cooking.

teaching.en: In the end, they settle the matter and write down the agreement.
teaching.es: Al final, resuelven el asunto y ponen por escrito el acuerdo.
teaching.explanationEs: Settle: cerrar un asunto. Agreement: el acuerdo, que se registra con sus condiciones.
segments: In the end, they settle the
matter and write down the agreement.
teaching.audioText: In the end, they settle the matter and write down the agreement.

prompt.es: Carlos hace una oferta con condición. ¿Qué frase lo hace?

choices.text: I'll pay the internet although you buy the food.
I'll pay the internet even so you buy the food.
I'll pay the internet provided that you buy the food.

feedback.es: Provided that + presente simple pone la condición de la oferta. Although y even so expresan contraste, no condición.

hint.es: Una oferta con condición exige algo a cambio: busca el conector de condición.

prompt.es: Completa: «Carlos hace una segunda concesión y acepta lavar los platos.»

feedback.es: Hacer una concesión es ceder algo a propósito; en inglés, make a concession.

hint.es: Es lo que haces cuando cedes algo para acercarte al otro.

origin.text: Carlos makes a second ___ and agrees to wash the dishes.

feedback.es: Settle the matter significa cerrar el asunto; aquí va en pasado, settled.

hint.es: Es el verbo para cerrar un asunto; va en pasado.

origin.text: In the end, they ___ the matter.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase de los compañeros de piso con su fase en la negociación.

pairs: Our total budget is five hundred dollars.
I'm afraid that is too high for me.
How about four hundred and fifty?
I'm willing to give in on the cleaning.
So we agree that the rent is four hundred.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una fase: fijar el total, rechazar con tacto, contraofertar, ceder y resumir el acuerdo.

pairs: Our total budget is five hundred dollars.
I'm afraid that is too high for me.
How about four hundred and fifty?
I'm willing to give in on the cleaning.
So we agree that the rent is four hundred.

prompt.es: Escucha a Carlos y elige hasta dónde está dispuesto a ceder.

choices.text: He will cook once a week, but not more often.
He will cook every day of the week.
He will not cook at all.

feedback.es: Carlos cede cocinando los domingos, pero su límite es no hacer más: una vez por semana.

origin.audio: I'll cook every Sunday, but I can't do more than that. That is my limit.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Acepto, siempre que la factura se reparta a partes iguales.»

answer.text: I accept as long as the bill is split equally

feedback.es: As long as va seguido de presente simple, aquí en pasiva: the bill is split.

prompt.es: En el chat de internet, ¿qué mensaje es la contraoferta de Carlos?

choices.text: I suggest we pay thirty each.

feedback.es: Carlos rechaza los treinta de Sara y propone veinticinco con «Would you take twenty-five?». Veintiocho es el cierre y treinta la oferta de Sara.

origin.text: Sara: The internet costs sixty dollars. I suggest we pay thirty each. Carlos: I'm afraid I can't pay thirty. Would you take twenty-five? Sara: Twenty-five is too low. Let's say twenty-eight. Carlos: Twenty-eight. It's a deal!

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué condición pone la hablante para ir a la fiesta.

choices.text: The other person must pay for the party.
The other person must choose the music.

feedback.es: As long as introduce la condición: ella irá si el otro elige la música. Although solo reconoce que no le gustan las fiestas.

origin.audio: Although I don't like parties, I'll come as long as you choose the music.

prompt.es: Completa el registro del acuerdo con la primera oferta de Tom y la condición final.

feedback.es: Tom empieza ofreciendo pagar el gas y al final pone como condición que Sara haga la compra.

sentences: Tom's first offer: he pays the ___.
The final condition: Sara must do the ___.
origin.text: Tom: I'll pay the gas provided that you pay the electricity. Sara: I can't. How about half each? Tom: Fine, as long as you do the shopping.

prompt.es: Escribe como Sara el acuerdo final con Tom: dos concesiones y una condición.

answer.text: Hi Tom, here is our final agreement. Our total budget is five hundred dollars a month. You first offered to pay the rent, provided that I paid the bills, but I suggested three hundred and two hundred because that is fair. In the end, we settled on that plan. I made a concession: I will also pay for the internet. You gave in on the cooking: you will cook on weekdays, as long as I clean the flat on Sundays. So we agree that the rent is three hundred and the bills are two hundred. Is that OK with you?
accepted: Hi Tom, here is our final agreement. Our total budget is five hundred dollars a month. You first offered to pay the rent, provided that I paid the bills, but I suggested three hundred and two hundred because that is fair. In the end, we settled on that plan. I made a concession: I will also pay for the internet. You gave in on the cooking: you will cook on weekdays, as long as I clean the flat on Sundays. So we agree that the rent is three hundred and the bills are two hundred. Is that OK with you?

Hi Tom, this is our agreement. The total budget is five hundred dollars a month. First you offered to pay the rent on condition that I paid the bills, but I'm afraid that was not fair, so I suggested three hundred and two hundred instead. As a concession, I am willing to pay for the internet too. You are ready to give in on the cooking, provided that I clean the flat on Sundays. In the end, we settled on this plan and we are both happy. So we agree that the rent is three hundred and the bills are two hundred. Is that fine with you?

feedback.es: El registro incluye el total, la oferta con condición, dos concesiones, el resumen y la confirmación final.

origin.text: Datos: presupuesto total de 500 dólares al mes. Tom ofreció pagar el alquiler si Sara pagaba las facturas; Sara contraofertó 300 y 200. Concesión de Sara: pagará también internet. Concesión de Tom: cocinará entre semana, siempre que Sara limpie los domingos. Cierra confirmando el acuerdo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase registra bien un acuerdo final?

choices.text: So we agree that Mia pays the internet and Carlos cooks on Sundays.
So we agree that Mia pays the internet and Carlos cook on Sundays.
So we agree that Mia pays the internet provided that Carlos will cook on Sundays.

feedback.es: Para registrar el acuerdo se usa So we agree that + verbos en presente con su -s de tercera persona. Hay que evitar cook sin -s y will después de provided that.

prompt.es: Completa: «A veces hay que ceder para cerrar el trato.»

feedback.es: Give in significa ceder ante el otro, que a menudo es lo que hace falta para cerrar un trato.

origin.text: Sometimes you have to ___ in to close the deal.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Al final, llegaron a un acuerdo justo.»

answer.text: In the end they reached a fair agreement

feedback.es: In the end abre la frase para contar cómo terminó la negociación.
